description: This file manages loading, normalizing, caching, and migrating session store data, including reading from disk, handling cache, and applying migrations.

methods.name: isSessionStoreRecord
methods.description: Type guard to check if a value is a session store record with string keys and SessionEntry values.

methods.name: normalizeSessionEntryDelivery
methods.description: Normalizes a SessionEntry's delivery fields and updates related fields if changes are detected.

methods.name: normalizeSessionStore
methods.description: Normalizes all entries in the session store.

methods.name: loadSessionStore
methods.description: Loads session store data from disk with cache support, retries on Windows, applies migrations, normalization, and caching.
